arStrings.szText: Weaken enemies by using Infusion Spells to deactivate Affixes on Monsters in Torment II or higher.
Use Infusion: {c_important}Smoldering Ember{/c} to deactivate the {icon:MonsterAffix_ChillingWind,2} {c_important}Chilling Winds{/c} Affix on Monsters
Use Infusion: {c_important}Nebulous Extract{/c} to deactivate the {icon:MonsterAffix_Summoner,2} {c_important}Summoner{/c} Affix on Monsters
Use Infusion: {c_important}Glacial Nimbus{/c} to deactivate the {icon:MonsterAffix_FireOrbs,2} {c_important}Explosive{/c} Affix on Monsters
Use Infusion: {c_important}Corrosive Vapor{/c} to deactivate the {icon:MonsterAffix_VampiricEnrage,2} {c_important}Vampiric{/c} Affix on Monsters
Use Infusion: {c_important}Thunderous Particle{/c} to deactivate the {icon:MonsterAffix_Suppressor,2} {c_important}Suppressor{/c} Affix on Monsters
